verdict.rationale: Fivetran documents a Hybrid Deployment model where processing agents run within the customer's own environment (fivetran-docs-42, fivetran-docs-45, fivetran-docs-26), which can support data residency by keeping data processing local rather than in Fivetran's cloud, and it also lets customers pick their destination cloud provider (GCP/AWS/Azure, fivetran-docs-19). However, there is no explicit documentation of choosing a specific storage/processing region or formal data-residency/compliance guarantees for the SaaS control plane. Missing for 10: explicit region-selection controls for Fivetran's managed/SaaS deployment, documented residency/compliance certifications (e.g., EU vs US hosting), and independent confirmation that hybrid deployment fully satisfies residency requirements.
